posts.text:
Proud to have the endorsement of Okaloosa County Sheriff Eric Aden.

Sheriff Aden has served the people of Okaloosa County across a law enforcement career that
began in 1995 — from patrol deputy, to school resource officer, to Sheriff of the county he grew up in.

I will always back the blue. As Governor, I'll make sure our law enforcement officers have the
resources, the pay, and the support that they deserve.

posts.text:
Nikki forgot her economic history. 

I explained this on The Breakfast Club back in 2024 and brought receipts. Democrats directly created rampant inflation. That led to the affordability crisis that Republicans are working to fix. Earlier this summer we saw the biggest one-month drop in inflation since 2020, and there’s more work to be done. 

We’re not going to let Democrats like David Jolly do the same thing all over again.

Moments like this mean the world to me.

Yvonne, thank you for your kind words, your prayers, and your support. I’m running to make Florida more affordable, cut costs for our families, and ensure the Florida Dream remains within reach for generations to come.

We’re just getting started.

Request it. Verify it. Count it.

August 18. Let’s go. 🇺🇸
